summary: A 1.00 ct oval lab-grown diamond framed by two triangular lab-grown emeralds of approximately 0.30 ct each, with hidden diamond detailing beneath the centre.
description:
A striking three-stone engagement ring featuring a brilliant oval lab-grown diamond centre, framed by two vivid lab-grown emerald side stones. Their triangular shapes create a bold contrast with the oval diamond while keeping a balanced silhouette.

A delicate row of hidden diamonds beneath the centre adds sparkle that reveals itself from the side. The refined 2 mm band gives the ring a substantial yet elegant profile.

Starting at $4,200 CAD, including a 1.00 ct oval lab-grown diamond and approximately 0.30 ct of lab-grown emerald on each side. Centre diamond size and other design elements can be customized on request. Metal specifications are confirmed with your personal quote.

details.Side stones: Two triangular lab-grown emeralds, approx. 0.30 ct each
